notes:
User is growing an Instagram presence and recently reached 600 followers, aiming to sustain momentum and increase likes, comments, and engagement. Their niche centers on writing: they are working on a manuscript and are a freelancer interested in sharing writing tips, research, behind-the-scenes material, and experiences with freelancing.

They especially enjoy BTS and user-generated content. Their cat, Luna, is popular with followers, so they plan to incorporate her into writing-related BTS content (e.g., Luna “supervising” work or a recurring “Luna’s Office Adventures” series).

Planned Instagram approach:
- Use a hybrid content rhythm: share manuscript snippets as sections are completed while maintaining a reasonably consistent posting frequency.
- Share manuscript, research notes, desk setup, brainstorming, outlining, and inspiration-board material in Stories.
- Use Stories interactively with Questions, polls, text, and stickers.
- Run UGC campaigns using a branded hashtag, simple prompts, incentives, contests, collaborations, and regular featuring while respecting contributors’ rights and intellectual property.
- Run a poll with “More writing tips and advice,” “More behind-the-scenes content,” and “More sneak peeks of my manuscript”; invite elaboration in comments. Afterward, share a concise, visually appealing results Story, thank participants, explain the insight, highlight the winner, and tease aligned upcoming content.

Upcoming Q&A:
- User chose to use Instagram Stories’ Question Sticker first.
- Theme: their writing process, freelancing, or other writing-related topics.
- They will announce it in advance, use a branded hashtag such as #QandAwith[YourName], specify the theme, and post reminders.
- They will answer a manageable selection of questions, group common themes, provide relevant resources when needed, and clearly set expectations that not every question may be answered. Unanswered themes may be addressed later.
- Reminder copy drafted: “Hey everyone! 🙋‍♀️ Just a quick reminder that I'll be hosting a Q&A session in my Instagram Story tomorrow! 🤔 Ask me anything about my writing process, freelancing, or anything else you're curious about. 📝 Use the ‘Question Sticker’ to submit your questions, and I'll do my best to answer as many as I can. 🙏 T
